01 / BRAND

Operational. Calm. African-forward.

A carton, a check and a simple wordmark. Editable SVGs are in public/brand. The visual signals a completed operational check—not science fiction.

Primary audience: Nigerian and African operations managers, business owners, warehouse supervisors, HR / training leads and logistics managers. Secondary audience: judges, partners and investors. Lead with practical readiness, not VR spectacle.

Navy#0F1B2APrimary action / headings
Off-white#F6F7F9Page background
Grey#DDE3E8Nonessential dividers
Brand green#00A86BProgress / navy-on-green
Amber#F2A93BWarning accent
Coral#E2574CError accent
Blue#2F6FEDFocus / information
Brand green is an accent, not a white-text button colour. Use navy text on #00A86B, or the accessible dark green #007E53 for normal text on white.

Type system / Manrope

Train for the everyday.Desktop hero 48–72 px · mobile 34–44 px
A clear next step.Section headings 32–44 px · cards 20–28 px
Practical tasks, explainable feedback and focused replay.Body 16–18 px · interactive labels at least 14 px · generous line height

XR is not a flat pixel canvas: the in-world board uses approximately 26 mm button lettering, paged details, large forgiving targets and adjustable tablet distance. Real angular readability and comfort must be verified on hardware.

02 / COMPONENTS

One action should feel like the next action.

Actions and focus

Book a Demo ↗Watch the walkthrough

Primary: navy fill / white text. Secondary: outlined, with an essential boundary. Keyboard focus: 3 px blue outline. Disabled controls stay visibly unavailable.

✓ Saved receiving line ⚠ Check the unit count

Status always uses icon + text, never colour alone. Keep one primary action per task stage.

Layout and content

  • Approx. 1,200 px maximum content width.
  • 12–16 px card corners and generous whitespace.
  • Self-hosted fonts and images; no CDN dependency.
  • Stack on mobile. Never require horizontal page scrolling.
  • Progressively disclose inspection, labels, unit recording, placement, review and final confirmation.
  • No invented customers, testimonials, contacts, biographies or pilot outcomes.
03 / INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE

A six-page website. A clear business journey.

Home / Product / Scenarios / For Businesses / About / Contact. Book a Demo remains the main business CTA. The form saves a request; it does not book a calendar appointment.

Desktop and mobile product wireframes

Only Stock Receiving & Shelf Audit is available as the focused immersive MVP. Picking / packing, customer service / queues, cash close, dispatch / routes and safety / hygiene are labelled Coming soon.
04 / ACTUAL PRODUCT EVIDENCE

Inspector. Receiving tablet. Saved result.

These are actual desktop application captures, not invented interfaces or physical-headset footage. The receiving form uses buttons, not free-text quantity entry.

Standard delivery: 8 cartons, 108 expected units / 106 actual. Accept 5 cartons / 76 sound units; quarantine 3 cartons / 30 physical units; record a 2-unit shortage. Harder replay: 12 cartons with separate 2-unit shortage and 2-unit overage.

Natural actions

  • Ray-pinch menus; near poke large controls.
  • Grab and rotate cartons and documents.
  • Drag / release to labelled zones.
  • One-handed essential actions.
  • Near-interactable text indicator.

Comfort and safeguards

  • Seated / stationary, approx. 1.5 × 1.5 m.
  • No walking required; use ray reach.
  • Adjustable distance and larger text.
  • Tracking / focus loss pauses the shift.
  • Optional subtle audio, always paired with text.
06 / MANAGER DASHBOARD CONCEPT

Practice results should lead to coaching.

ILLUSTRATIVE DATA · NOT PILOT RESULTS

BrightMart practice team

Fictional learnerScenarioScoreActive timeExceptionsNext focus
Amaka (example)BrightMart receiving88 / 100 · Good4:124 / 4Quantity and shelf checks
Ada (example)BrightMart receiving100 / 100 · Excellent5:314 / 4Harder delivery

Current implementation: one named shared demo workspace, invitation code, assignments with variant / target / focus / deadline, saved results and common error categories. Role views are not authentication or staff permissions.

Fixed 100-point allocation

  • Accuracy / 35: accepted placements up to 5 × 5, accurate unit records 5, correct identification 5. Wrong shelf or quantity attempts −5 each, clamped to 0–35.
  • Exceptions / 25: damage 5, expiry 5, SKU mismatch 5, per-item quantity discrepancy 5, safe quarantine 3, no unnecessary quarantine 2. Missed physical exceptions −5; unnecessary quarantine −2 each, clamped to 0–25.
  • Process / 25: note before handling, all inspected, labels / dates checked, complete form, explicitly submitted: five checks × 5.
  • Efficiency / 15: standard ≤6 min 15, ≤7 min 10, ≤8 min 5, otherwise 0. Pause time excluded. Custom target shifts these boundaries.

≥90 Excellent · ≥75 Good · ≥55 Developing · lower: Needs practice. More cartons do not inflate the dimension caps.

07 / DEMO REQUEST FORM

Request received is not appointment booked.

□ Consent to respond, with privacy link. No automatic marketing subscription.

Request a Demo →

Layout reference only. Use the working /contact or /for-businesses page to submit.

Implemented behaviour

  • Required name, business, email, industry, team size and main challenge. Phone optional.
  • Validation in the browser and on the server.
  • Private SQLite persistence and opaque receipt.
  • Honeypot plus a basic 5-per-5-minute IP limit.
  • No public contact-data listing.
  • 90-day cleanup at startup and new-request handling.
  • No automatic email, WhatsApp, CRM or calendar booking.
Do not publish unverified contact details, staff biographies or partner logos. No real staff / customer / medical information belongs in the shared practice demo.

09 / RELEASE GATES

Clear limits are part of a credible product.

This build contains

  • Six functional public pages and saved demo requests.
  • Eight-carton standard / twelve-carton harder receiving.
  • Fixed scoring, two-step submit and saved replay comparison.
  • Desktop / touch and hands-only WebXR paths.
  • Preserved legacy scenarios and historical snapshots.

Separate validation / deployment work

  • Physical Quest hands, passthrough, comfort and performance.
  • Private staff authentication / permissions and tenant isolation.
  • Production hosting, HTTPS, backups, data agreement and monitored operations.
  • Real-pilot evidence for error or onboarding improvements.
  • Competition eligibility / submission; no Meta SDK integration claim.

Brand and illustrations are not customer proof. Scores describe a fictional practice scenario, not hiring decisions, professional certification or guaranteed workplace competence.
